Tired of running back to your terminal? The §6ME Wireless Access Point §flets you access the network from anywhere within range.

Place it in a central location, connect it to your network, and any Wireless Terminal in range connects. Default range is 16 blocks. Add §6Wireless Boosters §fin the slot to extend it: 4 boosters reaches 24 blocks, and 16 boosters reaches 80 blocks.

Craft it from a Wireless Receiver, a Calculation Processor, and a Fluix Cable. It costs 1 channel from the host cable.

§ePS:§f Place it high up with clear line of sight for best range. Walls reduce effective distance. And yes, it works across dimensions with a Quantum Bridge.
